name: ladder-1
description: Global ladder ladder-1 (the user, 11-12 ~11:11; analyst 6.85): no training; each promising library model plays at its specified ply (its training ply), one entry per model; players at plies 1: 18, 2: 13, 3: 8, 4: 1; 10 double round-robins, near argmax (T 0.02). Elo 0 = random: the random references random, random-1, random-2 and random-3 (plies 0-3) play in the field (the user, 11-12 ~11:55: "for the global ladder we should add the random players back in"); the standing panels play as players, not as the anchor (the standing panels at plies 1,2 (ply 1 error-routing-p1, error-dag-probit-p1, grow-p1, grow-p1b at v300; ply 2 replay-p2, diversity-p2, probit-late-p2 at v299; an F-P and a tree each, first 1 replicate(s))). Selection: at plies with a standing panel, one entry per family in [{', '.join(fams)}] from the family's latest plateaued run, its final, the variant the record kept (LR trees forget 10, grow trees bar on, DAGs D-P z30 / D-L z160 or z120) else its first line; at plies without one, one entry per (run, family) of every finished run there; new-system runs only (no global champions, no mixed-ply, self-play or random-player runs); at most 16 a ply, references first; 2 reference(s) a ply also play at the next plies as depth anchors. It ranks deployed players (evaluator plus depth), not evaluators apart from depth: read fit.md.
